title: 내가 켠 불빛
suno_analysis_sp: K-Rock track featuring aggressive distorted electric guitars and driving live drums. The arrangement opens with a syncopated guitar riff using a bridge pickup tone before transitioning into a full-band texture. The bass guitar follows the kick drum patterns with a gritty, overdriven tone. Male vocals are delivered with a powerful, slightly raspy chest voice, shifting into high-energy belts during the chorus. The tempo is 145 BPM in the key of B minor. The drums utilize heavy crash cymbal accents and a punchy snare. A secondary lead guitar provides melodic counterpoint with a brighter, more saturated distortion.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[syncopated distorted electric guitar riff]
[drums enter with snare roll and crash]

[Verse 1]
[driving drums, bass with grit]
한밤중 열한 시야
모니터 불빛만 남아
사수자리는 비었어
[guitar riff intensifies]
설레게 주문했어
다 지우고 다시 써
에러 로그 앞에서
이를 악물고 있어

[Chorus]
[full band energy, heavy crash cymbals]
아무도 안 알려줘
아무도 안 가르쳐줘
이 밤을 혼자 버텨
모니터 앞에서 싸워
[half-time feel]
저 야근의 불
[final guitar chord rings out]
